facebook.caption: Tourists walk straight past this. Sùng Hưng Cổ Tự sits right on Đường Trần Hưng Đạo and almost nobody stops. One of Phu Quoc's oldest Chinese-Buddhist temples. Dragon pillars, incense smoke, total quiet. Free to enter. Takes 20 minutes. Feels like a different island. Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
facebook.video_caption: Step inside Sùng Hưng Cổ Tự while everyone else heads to the beach. Incense, dragon carvings, zero crowds. This is Phu Quoc at its most local.
